1612/*
1613 * Like LockThreadLocalBufferLogAppender (per-thread reused buffer, encode outside any
1614 * lock) but the final write is protected by a plain `synchronized` block on this
1615 * appender's own monitor instead of a ReentrantLock. Does not extend LockLogAppender -
1616 * there is no way to acquire a monitor in one method call and release it in another, so
1617 * this appender's critical sections are written as literal synchronized blocks instead.
1618 */
1619final class SynchronizedThreadLocalBufferLogAppender extends AbstractLogAppender implements InternalLogAppender {
1620
1621        private final Object monitor = new Object();
1622
1623        // See LockThreadLocalBufferLogAppender's identical field for why this suppression is
1624        // needed.
1625        @SuppressWarnings("nullness:type.argument")
1626        private final ThreadLocal<ThreadBuffer> bufferThreadLocal;
1627
1628        SynchronizedThreadLocalBufferLogAppender(String name, LogOutput output, LogEncoder encoder,
1629                        Set<LogAppender.AppenderFlag> flags, LogAlerts alerts, LogMetrics metrics) {
1630                super(name, output, encoder, flags, alerts, metrics);
1631                this.bufferThreadLocal = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> new ThreadBuffer(encoder.buffer(output.bufferHints())));
1632        }
1633
1634        @Override
1635        public void clearThreadLocals() {
1636                bufferThreadLocal.remove();
1637        }
1638
1639        @Override
1640        public void append(LogEvent event) {
1641                try {
1642                        var local = bufferThreadLocal.get();
1643                        // As LockThreadLocalBufferLogAppender: the monitor alone misses reentry while
1644                        // encoding.
1645                        boolean reentrant = local.inUse || Thread.holdsLock(monitor);
1646                        if (shouldDropForReentry(reentrant, flags, metrics, 1)) {
1647                                return;
1648                        }
1649                        try {
1650                                var buffer = reentrant ? encoder.buffer(output.bufferHints()) : local.acquire();
1651                                encoder.encode(event, buffer);
1652                                writeSynchronized(event, buffer);
1653                        }
1654                        finally {
1655                                if (!reentrant) {
1656                                        local.inUse = false;
1657                                }
1658                        }
1659                        appendSucceeded();
1660                }
1661                catch (Throwable e) {
1662                        appendFailed(e, 1, false);
1663                }
1664        }
1665
1666        private void writeSynchronized(LogEvent event, LogEncoder.Buffer buffer) {
1667                synchronized (monitor) {
1668                        output.write(event, buffer);
1669                        if (immediateFlush) {
1670                                output.flush();
1671                        }
1672                }
1673        }
1674
1675        @Override
1676        public void append(LogEvent[] events, int count) {
1677                try {
1678                        var local = bufferThreadLocal.get();
1679                        boolean reentrant = local.inUse || Thread.holdsLock(monitor);
1680                        if (shouldDropForReentry(reentrant, flags, metrics, count)) {
1681                                return;
1682                        }
1683                        try {
1684                                var buffer = reentrant ? encoder.buffer(output.bufferHints()) : local.acquire();
1685                                synchronized (monitor) {
1686                                        output.write(events, count, encoder, buffer);
1687                                        if (immediateFlush) {
1688                                                output.flush();
1689                                        }
1690                                }
1691                        }
1692                        finally {
1693                                if (!reentrant) {
1694                                        local.inUse = false;
1695                                }
1696                        }
1697                        if (count > 0) {
1698                                appendSucceeded();
1699                        }
1700                }
1701                catch (Throwable e) {
1702                        appendFailed(e, count, true);
1703                }
1704        }
1705
1706        @Override
1707        public void close() {
1708                synchronized (monitor) {
1709                        super.close();
1710                }
1711        }
1712
1713        @Override
1714        public List<LogEvent> act(LogAction action) {
1715                synchronized (monitor) {
1716                        return _request(action);
1717                }
1718        }
1719
1720}
